thread:
emi: Heads-up: PM stack wants a concise launch plan for private deployment networking. They asked for clear deploy modes, upgrade guarantees, and what we promise customers on day 1. Quick sync?

sam: Proposed minimal launch modes: `relay` (our managed egress, fastest time-to-live), `pinned-nat` (operator persists NAT mapping), and `bgp-preview` (handshake-only; no GA BGP).

jordan: Love that. Important to call out limitations: pinned-nat doesn't survive cloud-level IP reclaim in every provider. Must be explicit in docs.

field-anna: Field wants two things: preserved egress IP across routine upgrades, and a short maintenance window option for complex upgrades. Most customers will accept scheduled windows.

emi: Agree. Let's define acceptance for initial launch: 1) installer supports `--mode pinned-nat` and `--maintenance-window`; 2) operator can reassign same egress IP after control-plane restart in >95% of tests; 3) dry-run upgrade check exists (`rictl upgrade --dry-run`) that verifies binds.

sam: Telemetry gating too: show `egress_rebind_success` and `rebind_latency_ms` in Console. If rebind failure >1% during cutover, abort and roll back.

jordan: On upgrades: propose two profiles, `fast` and `safeguard`. Fast = best-effort with brief disruption risk; Safeguard = KV checksum + staged node cutover. Safeguard is required for customers with pinned-eips.

field-anna: Would pilots accept safeguard as opt-in? They prefer safeguards but want incremental rollout. We'll coordinate 3 pilots for alpha.

ops-bot: Ticket created PROD-6120: "private-deploy networking launch: pinned-nat + upgrade-profiles" assigned to @sam.

emi: Implementation notes: pinned-nat requires persisted mapping store in operator state and a reconciliation loop that detects IP reclaim and alerts. We should also ship a CLI helper: `rictl rebind --force` for support.

sam: Estimate: 3 engineer-weeks for operator + 1 week QA + 1 week docs/field. BGP-preview (handshake only) another 2 weeks for infra hooks. Full BGP GA depends on cloud adapters and is Q3-ish.

jordan: Migration story: offer a 'nat-to-bgp' path later. For now, provide clear handoff docs and an escrow pattern where we proxy traffic during BGP validation.

field-anna: Pilot acceptance criteria: 48h stability, successful dry-run validation, one planned rollback drill with field. I'll provide pilot list by Friday.

emi: Risk log: air-gapped customers need offline bundles + signed handshakes; HSM/KMS integration for keys in private deploy pushes to later. Document all as "known limitations" in PRD.

sam: Customer comms: two short FAQs: "What happens to my IP during upgrade?" and "When do I get BGP?". Field wants example CLI snippets and a rollback playbook.

jordan: QA matrix: cold restart, rolling upgrade, node replacement, cloud IP reclaim simulation, streaming-session stickiness. Must automate these in e2e harness.

ops-bot: Canary build (pinned-nat branch) available: http://ci.internal/builds/4256789125

field-anna: I'll set expectations with pilots: opt-in alpha, known caveats, daily health updates. We'll run two-week beta after initial pilot verification.

emi: Action items: sam -> start operator spike and open PR; jordan -> QA matrix + harness tasks; field-anna -> pilot confirmations; I'll update PRD and acceptance criteria doc.

sam: I'll add upgrade-profile CLI flags in the spike and demo next week.

jordan: Noted. Let's keep the initial surface narrow and measurable.
